entry: workspace-tools.mjs createWorkspaceToolHandlers().session (the session tool, actions list, send and create) over daemon-session-control.mjs createSessionControl, agent-task-sessions.mjs createAgentTaskSessions and the real session-service.mjs createSessionService on a stub runtime factory; seams: the catalog pages, the bot list, the live work, the archived flags, the report watches (refusing) and the projects

exclusions.a group room: a send to a room's log goes through the desktop room host; the core has none for the session tool and refuses it
exclusions.attached files: a file forwarded with send/create needs the caller's conversation files; the core refuses attachments in this runtime (session_port.rs resolve_attachments)
exclusions.model, effort, worktree: create and send with model, effort or worktree need the model catalog and the worktree host through the session service; the core refuses them
exclusions.random names: a created session id (sess_daemon_<ms>_<32 hex>) is <created>, a create's request id (atask_<uuid>) is <request> and the caller's folder (a temporary directory) is <WORK>
exclusions.reports: the report queue (watches, started line, final report) is not in the core; Node's answer to a watch it cannot store is recorded with that seam refusing
exclusions.service bookkeeping: a case records the catalog pages asked for (listSessions), the prompts the runtime took (runtime.submitAsync) and the session a create made (service.createSession); the service's own calls (materializeSession, the wrapper calls) and the log lines are Node internals; `skipSlashCommands`, which the service stamps on the prompt of a home chat, is dropped
exclusions.the route of a task: Node starts a task on the Lead route of the config, else the last used model; the core starts it through thread/start, whose default route is decided by the route service

normalised.reason: per-run temp path (or generated name) replaced by a placeholder

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder
